summary_1line: Nightfall battle rages; Duryodhana charges and devastates the Pandava ranks until Yudhishthira cuts his bow and wounds him, prompting Drona to intervene.

image_candidates.scene_text: Duryodhana's chariot thunders into the Pandava host as he showers blazing arrows like the midday sun scorching the battlefield.
Yudhishthira slices Duryodhana's golden-backed bow into three pieces with two broad-headed arrows as soldiers roar that the king is slain.
Infuriated elephants clash tusk to tusk amid a darkening battlefield filled with whistling arrows after sunset.
